title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 22: lost animals, a bird's nest, a railing on the roof, mixed things, and marriage laws.

questions.text: What were you to do with your brother's stray animal if he lived far away or you did not know him?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says to bring it home to your house and keep it until your brother comes looking for it, and then restore it to him.

answers.text: Sell it at the market and keep the money
Let it go free into the wild
Give it to the priest as an offering
Keep it at home until he came looking for it

questions.explanation: A woman shall not wear men's clothing, and a man shall not put on women's clothing.

answers.text: Wearing clothing of the opposite sex
Wearing a cloak without a belt

questions.text: What were you to do with the mother bird when you found a nest with young ones or eggs?
questions.explanation: Verses 6-7 say you shall not take the hen with the young; you shall surely let the hen go, but you may take the young.

answers.text: Take her together with the young
Keep her to raise more young

questions.text: What had to be made when building a new house?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says to make a railing around the roof, so that no blood comes on the house if anyone falls from there.

questions.text: What does verse 9 forbid regarding a vineyard?
questions.explanation: You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest all the fruit be defiled.

answers.text: Harvesting it in the seventh month
Sowing it with two kinds of seed
Selling its grapes to a foreigner

questions.text: Which two animals were not to plow together?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says: "You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together."

questions.text: Which two materials were not to be woven together in clothes?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says: "You shall not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together."

questions.text: Where were the Israelites to make fringes?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says they were to make fringes on the four corners of the cloak with which they cover themselves.

answers.text: On the sleeves of their tunic
On the collar of their robe
On the four corners of their cloak

questions.text: How much was a man fined for giving a bad name to a virgin of Israel he had married?
questions.explanation: The elders were to fine him one hundred shekels of silver and give them to the young lady's father.

questions.text: Why was nothing to be done to the young woman pledged to be married in verses 25-27?
questions.explanation: He found her in the field, she cried, and there was no one to save her; there was in her no sin worthy of death.

answers.text: Her father paid a fine to the elders for her
She cried out in the field and no one could save her
The elders of the city forgave her
She left the city and went to live elsewhere
